server.name: io.github.aniekanasuquookono-web/archiet
server.description: Archiet MCP server: scaffold full-stack apps from PRD text and extract capabilities.
server.title: Archiet

environmentVariables.description: Workspace-scoped Archiet API key (ak_...). Create one at https://archiet.com/settings/api-keys (Professional plan or higher).
environmentVariables.name: ARCHIET_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Archiet API base URL. Override for self-hosted or staging deployments.
environmentVariables.name: ARCHIET_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds. Codegen jobs can take several minutes.
environmentVariables.name: ARCHIET_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS

tools.description: Submit a PRD to Archiet's codegen pipeline. Returns a download URL for the generated ZIP plus the cert tier outcome (certified / shippable / repair_required) across 9 supported stacks: flask-nextjs, fastapi, django-nextjs, nestjs-nextjs, laravel-nextjs, go-chi, java-spring-boot, rails-nextjs, dotnet-nextjs.
tools.name: scaffold

tools.description: Extract the capabilities Archiet would generate for a PRD without running the full codegen pipeline. Useful for previewing scope before spending compute on a full scaffold.
tools.name: preview_capabilities
